text: Our IP titled System And Method For Development Of A Digital Twin For Improving Wireless Localization has been filed for patent protection.
Our paper titled Adaptive Threshold Learning for Robust First-Path Detection in UWB Ranging is presented in COMSNETS 2026.
Our paper titled iAirGuard: A Modular IoT Architecture with Dynamic Sampling and TinyML-Based Fault Detection for Air Quality Monitoring is presented in COMSNETS 2026.
Our paper titled ARGOS: Leveraging Visual Priors for Scalable Wireless Navigation in Dynamic Environments is selected to be presented in IEEE PerCom 2026.
Awarded the Institute Gold Medal for achieving the highest CGPA in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at NIT Durgapur.
Received the Institute Best Project Award at NIT Durgapur for the M.Tech. thesis I-VayuWise.
Joined the Ph.D. program in Computer Science and Engineering at Indian Institute of Technology Madras, Sensing and Networked Systems Engineering (SeNSE) Lab.
Our paper titled PolluSenseCheck: Cost Effective TinyML-based Air Quality Monitoring System with In-Built Sensor Fault Detection is presented in COMSNETS 2025.
Secured Second Place in the Best Student Idea category at IC-MNSS 2024 as part of Team PolluSense.
Joined as a Summer Researcher at Indian Institute of Technology Madras, working on Advanced Capacitive Sensing.
Our paper titled Efficient Air Quality Index Prediction on Resource-Constrained Devices using TinyML: Design, Implementation, and Evaluation is presented in ICDCN 2024.
Our paper titled Real-Time Air Quality Predictions for Smart Cities using TinyML is presented in ICDCN 2024.
Joined NIT Durgapur as an MTech Student in CSE.
